questions.question: What does a red octagon-shaped sign say?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means "stop." You must always come to a complete stop.

questions.question: Can you turn right at a red traffic light after stopping and yielding?
questions.explanation: You can turn right at a red light unless a sign forbids it. You must stop completely first and yield to other drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, what must you do?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crosswalks. You must stop for pedestrians in any crosswalk, marked or unmarked, unless a traffic signal tells them to wait.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: Is it illegal for people under 21 to drive with any trace of alcohol or drugs in their system?
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive with any trace of alcohol or drugs in your system. Drivers under 21 caught with any alcohol will lose their license for three months.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to slow down. The road ahead will turn sharply.

questions.question: Can you use parking lights instead of headlights when driving at night?
questions.explanation: You cannot drive at night using only parking lights. You must use your headlights when it is dark.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: A pedestrian crosses the street after the "Don't Walk" signal flashes. They are in the middle of the street when your light turns green. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed if you have the right-of-way.
Proceed if the pedestrian is not in your lane.
Wait until the pedestrian crosses the street before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the pedestrian crosses the street before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a green light, you must wait for pedestrians in the intersection. If a pedestrian is in the street, wait until they cross before you go.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: Farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back to warn other drivers they are slow-moving.

questions.question: What should you do to avoid losing traction on wet roads?
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed on wet roads to prevent hydroplaning. Keep your tires in good condition. If you lose control, release the gas pedal. Do not brake. Keep the vehicle straight and let it slow down naturally.

questions.question: Before changing lanes or passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Check your blind spots and mirrors.
Signal your intention before changing lanes.

questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to see your blind spot. These steps alert other drivers and keep you safe.

questions.question: You must yield to a pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog:

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading the person across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog signals that a person is blind or has low vision. You must always give them the right-of-way, whether or not they are crossing a street.

questions.question: When another vehicle is passing you:
questions.explanation: Let the passing vehicle go safely. Keep your speed steady and do not speed up. This gives the other driver room to pass and merge back into your lane.

questions.question: To get court supervision for a traffic violation, a minor must appear in court with a parent or legal guardian and attend traffic safety school.
questions.explanation: A driver under 18 who wants court supervision for a traffic violation must go to court with a parent or legal guardian. They must also attend traffic safety school.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign shows that left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns you of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: The three-second rule helps drivers determine a safe following distance.
questions.explanation: Use the three-second rule to keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to potential hazards. This sign warns you that a side road is entering ahead.

questions.question: Most rear-end collisions happen because the car behind is following too closely.
questions.explanation: Following too closely is the main cause of rear-end crashes.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, rain, or snow, it is hard to see and be seen. What should you turn on to let other drivers know you are there?
questions.explanation: Use your headlights when you cannot see other vehicles or when it is hard for others to see you. Turn on your low beam headlights if you need to use your windshield wipers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with no warning signals or gates, a driver should slow down, look, and listen.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with no warning devices, slow down and look both ways. Listen for a train. Only cross when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that you could lose control. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, you should wait until the entire car is visible in your rearview mirror before moving back to the right lane.
questions.explanation: After passing, do not return to the right lane until you can see the entire car you passed in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: When should you adjust your rearview and side mirrors?

options.text: Whenever you need to use them.
Before you get into the car.

questions.explanation: Before driving, adjust your seat, mirrors, and safety belt and secure items in your car. Do not adjust mirrors while your vehicle is moving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is changing direction or getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: Your car must have a horn that can be heard from 200 feet away.
questions.explanation: All vehicles must have a horn that can be heard from 200 feet away. Only emergency vehicles can use sirens, whistles, and bells.

questions.question: A train has passed at a railroad crossing. What should you do next?

options.text: Wait for the signal lights to stop flashing.

questions.explanation: Even after a train passes, watch for a second train on any track. Do not move until all gates are raised and all warning lights have stopped flashing.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. When you see it, be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic from the right will merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic from the right will merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: A school bus ahead is stopped to pick up or drop off children. What must you do?

options.text: Stop completely until all children leave the bus.
Stop completely until the red lights stop flashing and the stop arm goes up.
Change lanes and pass the bus slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely until the red lights stop flashing and the stop arm goes up.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has flashing red lights and its stop arm out, you must stop completely. Do not move until the lights stop flashing and the stop arm is raised. Even then, make sure no children are crossing the road before you go.

questions.question: Your car breaks down on the highway. What should you do?

options.text: Move completely off the road if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move completely off the road if possible.
questions.explanation: If your car breaks down, move it completely off the main road if you can.
